jobs.description:
1 Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC)  * You will develop and validate numerical signal processing algorithms for mobile 5G/6G ISAC scenarios using simulations and measurements from an SDR testbed combining RF, fiber optic, and quantum sensing.
 * Depending on your background, you will conduct algorithm research and contribute to real-time experiments using SDR hardware and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS).

 * Together with experienced colleagues, you will engage in establishing a unique 6G distributed MIMO sensing testbed based on SDR technology using open-source tools such as GNU Radio, RFNoC and LabVIEW for real-time FPGA algorithm design operating from 0.4 - 20 GHz.

 * You will learn how to evaluate the results and prepare them for further studies.
 * You will publish your research results in international journals and present them at conferences.
 * You will accumulate experience in a research field, that has an enormous range of applications from construction, logistics, aviation and railways to agriculture, robotics and defense.
 * You will gain experience in a group of international scientists and build up your professional network within European wide research projects.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering
 * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) multi-static MIMO UAV sensing, (ii) quantum sensing with NV centers and Rydberg cells, (iii) multimodal sensing with fiber optic and distributed RF sensors, or (iv) ISAC using reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) and two-way ranging. Candidates should indicate in their cover letter how their background and interests align with one of these profiles (i-iv) and provide evidence of relevant expertise. Applications not addressing this point may not be considered.
 * Hands-on experience in radio frequency (RF) lab experimentation and printed circuit board design for the profiles listed above.
 * Excellent knowledge in the field of signal processing, RF propagation modeling, AI/ML and numerical simulation software development (MATLAB or Python)
 * Sound knowledge of electromagnetic field simulation tools, antenna design, and real-time FPGA programming.
 * Interest in reading and writing scientific publications and enjoyment of solving application-oriented questions from industry
 * High level of commitment and ability to work in a team
 * German and English skills commensurate with the role

 

What to expect: 

 * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 56.784,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience.
 * Our employee benefits include meal allowances, healthcare benefits, pension support, family benefits, additional days off, vouchers, sports and cultural activities, and flexible working models including up to 50% home office.We also support conference participation, networking, and individual training and career development opportunities.

 

We encourage our Junior Scientist (f/m/d) to pursue a doctoral degree at TU Wien. 

Through the AIT-PhD programme with renowned universities, you will have the opportunity to conduct your PhD thesis in collaboration with AIT experts and national and international research partners.

 

At AIT, we foster an inclusive and family-friendly work environment that promotes equal opportunities and values diversity across all levels of the organisation. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.

jobs.description:
1 Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems  * As part of our interdisciplinary team, you support the design, development and validation of high-power isolated power converters up to MW range as well as the development of converter topologies for medium-voltage applications up to 30 kV.
 * You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures.
 * You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components.
 * You perform electrical, thermal, and magnetic simulations using tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice/PSIM, and ANSYS Maxwell or other FEM-based tools.
 * You define power-stage architectures, including semiconductor selection (SiC, IGBT, MOSFET), gate-driver design, protection concepts, and EMC/EMI mitigation measures.

 * You collaborate closely with mechanical, control, and system engineers to ensure successful end-to-end product integration.
 * You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines.
 * You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware.
 * You work on research and development projects, prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues.
 * You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders.
 * You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
 *  Experience in power electronic systems
 * Expertise in medium voltage systems (up to 20 kV), high-power converters (up to MW), and isolated converter topologies.
 * Understanding of medium-frequency transformer design, medium-voltage insulation systems, magnetic components, and thermal management.
 * Experience with wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC preferred)
 * Knowledge of power converter control strategies, including closed-loop control, PWM techniques, and digital control systems.
 * Familiarity with laboratory equipment for medium-voltage testing and power analysis
 * Ability to troubleshoot complex power electronic systems
 * business-fluent English ; German skills are a nice to have.

 

What to expect:

 * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 61.334,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. In addition, we offer company benefits, flexible working conditions (incl. Home-Office) and individual training and career opportunities.
 * Mentorship and training in embedded firmware and power systems
 * The opportunity to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge power converter technologies in a collaborative and innovative engineering environment.

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates and documents, as well as a proof of identity.

jobs.description:
1 Head of Test Field (f/m/d) - Transformers Repair Center Linz 
A Snapshot of Your Day

As the Head of High Voltage Power Transformer Test Field at our new Siemens Energy Transformers Repair Center in Linz, Austria, you will play a pivotal role within the organization planning, developing, and advising the testing of the power transformer. You will lead employees according to the Company's goals and current regulations and provide the necessary resources. You will ensure and develop your team's specialist knowledge and supply to the development of business processes.

How You'll Make an Impact

 * Take charge of the test department by planning and performing power transformer tests in accordance with established standards and customer requirements.
 * Coordinate all logistical aspects of testing, including equipment certification, maintenance, procurement, and the creation of a testing schedule that meets delivery timelines and customer demands.
 * Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements throughout the testing process.
 * Analyze testing issues, lead investigations, and collaborate with the engineering department, providing detailed reports to the plant manager.
 * Propose actionable recommendations to enhance test efficiency, optimize processes, and improve testing tools.
 * Communicate and collaborate effectively with internal departments to drive business objectives and deliver timely test results while embodying Siemens Energy's core values of safety and integrity.

What You Bring

 * University degree or equivalent experience in engineering or a related field
 * Several years of hands-on experience in high voltage testing of power transformers or HV components or HV electrical systems.
 * Profound experience in personnel management, demonstrating the ability to lead and develop teams optimally.
 * Proven leadership skills, marked by a strong dedication to achieving results and the capacity to engage and empower team members.
 * Extensive knowledge of testing tools and technologies, as well as electric power testing equipment and system development processes, along with an understanding of IEC and IEEE testing standards.
 * Proficiency in English and German is required for collaboration with internal and external partners.

About the Team

Our Grid Technologies division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Rewards/Benefits

 * The opportunity to engage in an exciting environment on meaningful projects
 * Opportunities for career growth within a supportive workplace culture
 * International environment, along with a pension fund
 * Enjoy flexible working hours and the option to work from home
 * Access to a canteen or meal allowances
 * And more!

Siemens Energy is proud to be recognized as a top employer on Kununu, reflecting our commitment to creating an exceptional workplace for our employees.

At Siemens Energy we offer competitive compensation and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. Due to the Austrian legal regulations, we are obliged to state the minimum salary for this position. Please note that there is a clear willingness for a higher compensation considering your individual expectations, expertise and skills. The minimum salary for this position in the collective agreement for the electrical and electronics industry is in the amount of 81.580,80 € gross/year for a full-time position (38,5 h/week).
